artworks.title: Joconde: Le depart
artworks.artist: after Jean-Jacques-François Le Barbier I
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals in an interior setting. Two men stand to the left, one holding a feathered hat, while the other has his hand on his chest. Both are dressed in period attire with doublets, short trousers, and stockings. The man holding the hat has shoulder-length curly hair, and the other wears a decorative hat with feathers. To the right, a woman is seated in an armchair, wearing an elegant gown with ruffles. She has an updo with curls and appears to be holding a ribbon or sash extended towards the standing man with the feathered hat. The room is ornately decorated with patterned walls and intricate moldings. In the background, an open doorway reveals a staircase and another figure on the steps. The floor is tiled, and there is a table with a fringed cloth in the foreground.

artworks.title: Joconde: Le depart
artworks.artist: after Jean-Jacques-François Le Barbier I
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a formal interior setting. The central figure is a man standing and facing slightly to the right. He is wearing a doublet with a sash tied at the waist, breeches, a feathered hat, and curly hair. To his left stands another man holding a feathered hat, with curled hair. On the right, a woman is seated, leaning forward, holding the hand of the central figure, with adorned hair and a long gown with detailed sleeves. The room is richly decorated with elaborate wall patterns and a large patterned floor. In the background to the left, there is a staircase with a visible painting or sculpture at the top.

artworks.title: Joconde: Le lit
artworks.artist: Charles Louis Lingée after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a bedroom. One person with curly hair is sitting on a bed and reaching out to another individual. The second person, with shaggy hair, is holding a sheet and leaning over the bed. The third person is lying down on the bed, covered by a blanket. The room has a large canopy over the bed, draped curtains, a framed oval picture or mirror on the wall, a jug on a piece of furniture, a patterned floor, and a footstool beside the bed.

artworks.title: Joconde: Le lit
artworks.artist: Charles Louis Lingée after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior bedchamber scene with draped bed and furniture. The image shows a moment of intimacy and tension within an opulently furnished bedroom. The focal point is the canopy bed with elaborate drapery. Two figures are interacting in the center of the scene, with one under the bed linens and another beside the bed holding the covers. The room contains additional details like a pitcher on a side table, and an ornate chair, giving an air of luxury and privacy. Soft shading techniques are used to highlight the fabrics and shadows.

artworks.title: Joconde: Le lit
artworks.artist: Charles Louis Lingée after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This image depicts an interior scene featuring a bed with rich drapery. The drawing showcases an ornate bedroom setting with a large canopied bed surrounded by flowing curtains. The room is dimly lit, emphasizing the luxurious and private ambiance. Details like a pitcher on a table and a framed picture on the wall enhance the classic and intimate atmosphere. The artwork conveys a sense of elegance and intimacy through textures and spatial composition.

artworks.title: Joconde: Le pardon
artworks.artist: Philippe Triere after Jean-Baptiste Mallet
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length, standing figures and one kneeling figure within an interior setting. The standing individuals are positioned side by side. They both have curly hair. The individual on the left is wearing a large feathered hat. The standing figures are wearing ornate clothing with ruffled collars and fitted trousers. The kneeling person is leaning slightly to one side, resting their head on their hand. They are dressed in a long, flowing gown with a headband adorned with flowers. Around them, there is a table with an inkwell and an open book. The background reveals a wall with a decorative mantelpiece, an elaborate chair with a sword propped against it, and heavy drapery hanging to the side. The setting suggests an opulent and classically furnished room with large, arched windows.

artworks.title: Joconde: Le pardon
artworks.artist: Philippe Triere after Jean-Baptiste Mallet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical interior scene with elaborate architectural details and period costumes. The image depicts an ornate room featuring a high ceiling with decorative arches and a large window with an intricate diamond-pane design. A person is kneeling beside a table that is covered with papers and a writing quill. Adjacent to this figure, two elaborately dressed figures stand, adorned in period-style costumes, with one of them holding a plumed hat. Behind them, a richly adorned chair is visible and draped with cloth.

artworks.title: Le cocu battu et content
artworks.artist: Jean-Louis Delignon and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate interior scene featuring two figures, a screen, and furniture. The drawing depicts an elegantly dressed figure standing near a decorative folding screen, while another figure is bent over near the front. The room is opulently decorated with detailed wallpaper, a candelabra on the wall, and a plush armchair with an elaborately carved frame. The intricate design features, such as the patterned floor and the draped curtains, add a rich layer of depth to the image.

artworks.title: Le cocu battu et content
artworks.artist: Jean-Louis Delignon and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows three figures: two adults and one child, all displayed in full. The woman stands to the right with her hand on her hip, showing an expression of surprise or concern. She has curly hair styled up and wears an elaborate gown with ruffles and lace. The man in the foreground is bending over, possibly gathering fabrics. He wears a blouse with long sleeves and a sash at the waist, with his hair wrapped in a headscarf or turban. To the left, a small dog with long, fluffy fur is seated on a chair. In the background, there is an ornate room divider. Behind it, a child looks over with short, curly hair. The background includes decorative drapery and an elegant chandelier with lit candles, implying an opulent interior setting.

artworks.title: Le cocu battu et content
artworks.artist: Jean-Louis Delignon and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a man in elaborate historical attire. The woman stands on the right in a detailed gown, while the man on the left bends forward. In the background, a third person's head is visible behind curtains, with a small dog resting on a chair nearby. The setting is a luxurious room with patterned walls, heavy drapery, and an intricate chandelier hanging above.

artworks.title: Le cocu battu et content
artworks.artist: Jean-Louis Delignon and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing to the right and a man bending forward to the left. The woman has one hand raised to her chin and the other holding a draped piece of fabric. She has styled hair adorned with flowers and delicate facial features. She wears an ornate dress with ruffles and lace. The man is dressed casually and wears a cap with a bow. He seems to be handling a striped fabric. In the background, there is a decorative folding screen with elaborate designs and another character partially hidden behind a curtain. A small dog rests on an ornate chair to the left. The setting shows an opulently furnished interior with patterned wallpaper and elegant drapery, along with a wall sconce with two candles.

artworks.title: Le mari confesseur
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Tilliard and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five people in an ornate interior. A woman is seated in the center, with a man kneeling and kissing her hand. Two men are seated to her right, engaged in conversation, and another man stands by the doorway holding a curtain open. All are dressed in elaborate 18th-century attire. In the foreground, a small dog is present, and the background features grand architectural elements including tall columns, a decorative wall, and portraits.

artworks.title: Le mari confesseur
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Tilliard and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This image shows a group of individuals in an elaborate room. In the center, a woman sits on a fancy chair in an 18th-century style dress. Several men surround her, wearing luxurious period-appropriate clothing. One man kneels and kisses her hand, while two others lean over the chair and another sits nearby. A fifth man stands to the left, holding back a drape, dressed elegantly with a feathered hat and a cane. A small dog is on the floor in the foreground. The background features a decorative wall with a relief carving, lit candelabras, and ornate architectural elements like columns and high ceilings, emphasizing the setting's grandeur.

artworks.title: Le savetier
artworks.artist: Jean Dambrun after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an attic scene involving three people. The drawing depicts a chaotic interior scene set in an attic room with a high pitched ceiling. The composition features a narrative moment where two individuals on a bed appear to be surprised by another figure emerging from behind a curtain or drapery on the left. The setting is filled with various objects such as baskets, a painting hung on the wall, and multiple items scattered on the floor. The intricate line work and shading create depth and texture, emphasizing the dramatic atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Le savetier
artworks.artist: Jean Dambrun after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.medium: etching and engraving touched with China ink
artworks.description: The image shows three figures: one seated and two others partially reclined on a bed. The standing figure is a woman leaning slightly forward from behind a curtain, observing the scene in the bed. She has long hair and wears a headscarf. The woman on the bed lies back with her head thrown back and mouth open. She has styled hair with curls and is wearing a long, flowing dress with ruffled sleeves. Next to her sits a man holding a piece of paper in one hand. He has short, wavy hair and wears a suit with stockings and shoes. The room is cluttered with items such as pots, a basket, an overturned chair, and scattered wooden boards. The walls are adorned with paintings and shelves holding various objects, suggesting a rural or rustic setting. Wooden beams can be seen on the ceiling.

artworks.title: Le savetier
artworks.artist: Jean Dambrun after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image contains two people on a bed in a cluttered room. The man is sitting on the edge with a piece of paper, and the woman is reclining with one arm raised. A third figure peeks from behind a curtain. The room has hanging frames, a shelf with small objects, and exposed beams on the ceiling.

artworks.title: Le savetier
artworks.artist: Jean Dambrun after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in an enclosed room. The central male figure is seated on a bed, holding a document, with one arm around a woman next to him. She has curly hair, exposed shoulders, and wears a loose dress. A young boy peers from behind a drapery on the left. The room has a sloped ceiling with wooden beams, shelves with objects, and framed pictures. Objects like vases, a teapot, and framed pictures are visible on the walls. There is a partially concealed door at the bottom. Various objects are scattered on the floor near the bed.

artworks.title: Le paysan
artworks.artist: Charles Louis Lingée after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered in an architectural setting. The scene is set in a grand interior with an arched, decorated ceiling and large stone pillars. Within this environment, a group of individuals are depicted interacting in various positions and expressions. A person is kneeling on the floor surrounded by others who stand or lean, all wearing intricate period clothing. A statue of a classical figure is displayed to the side. The drawing uses fine lines and cross-hatching for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Le paysan
artworks.artist: Charles Louis Lingée after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image features six male figures and a statue in an architectural setting. Starting from the left, one man is holding a bundle of sticks on his shoulder. Another man is kneeling with raised hands. Next to them, two men are leaning on a column. To the right, a seated man watches the scene, with a statue of a woman in flowing robes behind him. The setting includes tall pillars and an intricately detailed vaulted ceiling.

artworks.title: Le paysan
artworks.artist: Charles Louis Lingée after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five men and a statue within an elaborate architectural setting. Four men stand on the left side: one man holds a platter of grapes, another carries a bundle of sticks on his shoulder, and a third is kneeling with his hand up as if surprised. Two other men, dressed similarly, stand behind him. To the far right, a man is seated in a chair, looking towards the scene on his left, wearing an ornate coat with lace. A cap lies on the ground in front of the kneeling man. Behind them stands a large statue of a figure in classical robes and a helmet, with one arm slightly raised. The background includes tall pillars and a decorated arched ceiling, conveying formality and grandeur.

artworks.title: Le paysan
artworks.artist: Charles Louis Lingée after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals in an architectural setting with a statue. The scene depicts five figures arranged in an interior space dominated by large columns and a statue in the background. The statue is dressed in classical attire and wearing a helmet. In the foreground, a person is kneeling in a dramatic pose, one arm raised and the other hand clutching their chest, while another person holds a tray of items towards them. A few other figures stand or sit around, observing, each with distinct expressions and gestures. The figures are arranged dynamically, and their clothing and gestures suggest a narrative moment. The architectural details include a vaulted ceiling and detailed columns.

artworks.title: Le muletier
artworks.artist: after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring architectural elements and animals. The scene includes a rustic room with two large stone pillars, a wooden loft or upper storage space, agricultural tools, a wooden contraption, draperies, tethered horse heads, and a neatly made bed with a detailed blanket or coverlet.

artworks.title: La gageure des trois commeres: La servante
artworks.artist: Philippe Triere and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate bedroom scene. The image depicts an intricately detailed interior setting. A canopy bed with draped curtains is on the right side. Above the bed, a patterned frieze decorates the wall. An artwork in a frame hangs on the wall behind two figures engaged in a scene. The bed is luxurious and ornate with a detailed headboard and flowing canopy. The drawing captures an atmospheric sense of intimacy and a refined decorative style through attention to texture and light play.

artworks.title: La gageure des trois commeres: La servante
artworks.artist: Philippe Triere and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bedroom scene. The room features a four-poster bed with luxurious curtains. The bedding includes multiple pillows. A candlestick is on a bedside table next to the bed. The room has decorative moldings and a framed artwork on the wall. On the floor, there is a round object resembling a warming pan. Light and shadow are used to enhance the textures and realism of the furniture and fabrics.
